changes.decision: No deterministic network/class-wide direct tariff may be applied. Uattzy is the current public-charging brand formed from E-Shore, GASGAS and EnerMia; its first-party site states Uattzy defines tariffs in at least one deployment model, while current observed direct/ad-hoc prices vary by station/power context. Require deterministic EVSE/station -> Uattzy direct/ad-hoc tariff mapping before rankable promotion.
positiveEvidence: https://www.uattzy.com/ : Uattzy states it is the public-charging brand of UAU formed from E-Shore, GASGAS and EnerMia and operates as CPO/eMSP.
https://enermia.org/ : EnerMia/E-Shore states the app has become Uattzy and legacy-branded stations are progressively being rebranded.
Adiconsum May 2026 observatory groups UATTZY (GASGAS - E-SHORE - ENERMIA) and reports an average proprietary-app price, not a deterministic universal tariff.
corroborationOnly: GoingElectric Palmanova Contrada Contarini: IT*UTZ*EC167/EC168, 22 kW AC, direct ad-hoc 0.62 EUR/kWh, updated 2026-09-08.
GoingElectric Palmanova Via Scamozzi: Uattzy 47 kW DC, direct ad-hoc 0.72 EUR/kWh.
negativePaths: Do not promote Adiconsum/TariffEV average proprietary-app value as a direct universal tariff.
Do not infer a universal ESH tariff from isolated UTZ/GAS/Uattzy station observations.
Do not collapse current ESH and GAS PUN partyIds into one counted partyId solely because they share the Uattzy commercial lineage.
changes.blockingCondition: deterministic current IT*ESH EVSE/station -> Uattzy direct/ad-hoc tariff mapping or first-party publication proving exact universal/class-wide scope

coherence.reason: ESH was already a named current partial; only priority changed from class-wide to station-level.
coherence.aliasPolicy: Uattzy commercial lineage is recorded without merging distinct current PUN partyIds ESH/GAS.

next: Continue remaining genuine network-wide/class-wide candidates before station-level; Atlante remains last.
